_doc: Larry's portfolio dial (Operator Feed Loop slice 4). One entry per project the factory builds/maintains. `weight` = the percentage-split throughput allocation (should sum to ~1.0) — retune weekly, no code change. `north_star` is what 'benefit' means for that project's cards; the rank brain scores each card's contribution to ITS project's north star, times the project weight, minus build cost. `repos` maps a mission card (its `repo` field) to its project; the `default: true` project catches unmapped/None repos. `stage`: active-build | steady-maintenance | exploration | handed-off (handed-off leaves active scope).

projects.name: RSDPM (first external product)
projects.north_star: Deliver RSDPM to first customer value: working product features, delivery infrastructure (bootstrap, auth/RLS, ingestion, CI), and anything on the critical path to a client using it. Repo TBD — add it to `repos` the day it exists.

projects.name: Factory (agent-core + surfaces)
projects.north_star: Keep the factory able to deliver the portfolio hands-free: build throughput, earned autonomy (operator loops), less Larry toil, less alert noise. Factory work earns rank through its leverage on product delivery, not for its own sake.

projects.name: Exploration / unassigned
projects.north_star: Ideas that open a future product or a step-change in factory capability. Default bucket for cards whose repo maps to no project.
